content:
Sony has confirmed the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December, which will be available to download from Tuesday, December 1 to Monday January 4.

In a PlayStation Blog post, Sony said Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, and Amnesia: The Bunker are December’s three titles. Will you be able to tear yourself away from GTA 6 to give either of these games a shot? Or perhaps you're after a palate cleanser after pumping 100 hours into Rockstar's epic?

IGN's Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 review returned an 8/10. We said: "Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 proves yet again the series’ over-the-top skateboarding formula is totally timeless, even if some of the changes to THPS4 miss the mark and the soundtrack has been fumbled."

Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, meanwhile, got a 7.5 back in 2017. "Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 is an ambitious, if rough-edged experience, with deceptively deep RPG and brawling elements," we said at the time.

And our Amnesia: The Bunker review returned an 8. We said: "Amnesia: The Bunker is a smaller, more self-contained episode in the groundbreaking horror franchise that shows Frictional still has some chilling new tricks up their sleeves."

PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December 2026

Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4 – Cross-Gen Edition | PS5, PS4

Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 | PS5, PS4

Amnesia: The Bunker | PS4

It’s worth noting that PlayStation Plus members have until Monday, November 30 to add the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for November (Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered, Monster Train 2) to their library.
